adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed validation in `handleAdd` but is only cleared in the Cancel button handler; it is not cleared on input edits (`MultiEmail` only updates `multiEmailValue`) nor in `addGuestsMutation.onSuccess` (which closes + resets `multiEmailValue` but leaves `isInvalidEmail` unchanged). Also, closing the dialog via overlay/Escape triggers `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` without resetting either `isInvalidEmail` or `multiEmailValue`, so stale error state and previous inputs can persist when reopening.
